description: This file defines a class Dompdf extending the base Pdf class for generating PDF documents using the Dompdf library within the PhpSpreadsheet project. It includes methods for creating the external PDF library instance, saving spreadsheets to PDF files, and configuring page setup details.

classes.name: Dompdf
classes.description: A class for rendering PDFs using the Dompdf library, extending the base Pdf class with specific implementation details for creating the library instance and saving PDF files.

methods.name: createExternalWriterInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the external Dompdf library used for PDF generation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Generates a PDF from the spreadsheet data and saves it to the specified filename, handling page setup and rendering.
